exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Choosing to Study Agriculture
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: What do you want to study at university, Tom?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I've decided to study agriculture.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Agriculture? That's not a common choice. Why?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: My grandparents are farmers, and I grew up in the fields.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: So you really love working the land.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I do. And I want to help farmers grow more food.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Like Yuan Longping, the father of hybrid rice?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Exactly. He is the reason I want to do this.

exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 问 Tom 想上大学读什么;Tom 决定学农业;因为祖父母是农民,他在田里长大,真心热爱耕作;他想帮农民种出更多粮食;像杂交水稻之父袁隆平那样,袁隆平正是他立志学农的原因。

questions.stem: What does Tom want to study?
Why is Tom interested in this subject?
options: He grew up in the fields with farming grandparents.
He wants to leave the countryside.
He thinks it is the easiest subject.

questions.stem: What does Tom hope to do in the future?
Who does Tom mention as his model?
How does Lucy feel about Tom's choice at first?
options: She thinks it is an unusual choice.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 The Problem of World Hunger
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: World hunger is still a serious problem today.
About one in ten people on the planet does not get enough food.
Wars can heavily affect how food is grown and moved.
Many poor families simply cannot afford to eat well.
Helping farmers grow more food is one important way to fight hunger.
exercises.translation_cn: 如今世界饥饿仍是严重问题;地球上约十分之一的人吃不饱;战争会严重影响粮食的种植和运输;许多贫困家庭根本吃不起好的食物;帮助农民种出更多粮食是抗击饥饿的重要途径之一。

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about world hunger?
options: It is still a serious problem today.

questions.stem: About how many people do not get enough food?
How can wars affect food, according to the passage?
options: They affect how food is grown and moved.
They have no effect on food.

questions.stem: Why can't many poor families eat well?
What is one important way to fight hunger?

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Organic or Chemical?
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: These apples are cheaper, but I'm buying the organic ones.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Why? The cheaper ones look just as good.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Organic food is grown without chemical pesticides.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Does that really make a difference?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes. Chemicals can stay in the soil and even in the food.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: I see. So organic food may be safer for us.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: That's right. It often has more flavour too.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: All right, I'll try the organic ones this time.

exercises.translation_cn: Anna 宁愿买稍贵的有机苹果;Ben 不解,觉得便宜的看着一样好;Anna 解释有机食品不用化学杀虫剂;化学品会残留在土壤甚至食物中;有机食品对人更安全,味道往往也更好;Ben 决定这次也试试有机的。

questions.stem: Which apples does Anna decide to buy?
How is organic food grown?
Why does Anna think chemicals are a problem?
options: They can stay in the soil and food.
They have no effect at all.

questions.stem: What does Anna say about the flavour of organic food?
What does Ben decide at the end?
options: To try the organic apples this time.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 A Man of the Soil
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Yuan Longping spent his whole life working the land.
He developed the first hybrid rice that farmers could really use.
His new rice gave a much higher yield than older crops.
Even after he grew rich, he still lived like a simple farmer.
His dream was to keep all people away from hunger.
exercises.translation_cn: 袁隆平一生都在耕耘土地;他培育出第一种农民真正能用的杂交水稻;新稻的产量远高于旧作物;即使富有了,他仍像普通农民一样生活;他的梦想是让所有人远离饥饿。

questions.stem: What did Yuan Longping spend his whole life doing?
What did Yuan develop?
How did his new rice compare with older crops?
options: It gave a much higher yield.

questions.stem: How did Yuan live after he grew rich?
options: He still lived like a simple farmer.

questions.stem: What was Yuan's dream?
options: To keep all people away from hunger.

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Helping on the Farm
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Grandpa
transcript.text: Could you help me in the fields this weekend, Kate?

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text: Of course, Grandpa. What do you need me to do?

transcript.speaker: Grandpa
transcript.text: We need to change the crop in the east field.

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text: Why do we change it every year?

transcript.speaker: Grandpa
transcript.text: Different crops put different minerals back into the soil.

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text: So that keeps the land rich and healthy.

transcript.speaker: Grandpa
transcript.text: Exactly. Last year we grew wheat, so this year we'll grow beans.

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text: I understand now. Farming takes real care.

exercises.translation_cn: 爷爷请 Kate 周末到田里帮忙;Kate 答应,问要做什么;爷爷说要给东边那块地换种作物;Kate 问为什么每年都换;因为不同作物把不同矿物质还回土壤,使土地保持肥沃健康;去年种小麦,今年种豆子;Kate 明白了:务农需要真正的用心。

questions.stem: What does Grandpa ask Kate to do?
What job needs doing in the east field?
Why does Grandpa change the crop every year?
options: Because different crops return different minerals to the soil.
Because the field is too small.

questions.stem: What did they grow last year, and what now?
What does Kate learn from the talk?
options: Farming is a waste of time.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 World Food Day
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: World Food Day is held every year in October.
It is celebrated in more than one hundred and fifty countries.
The day reminds people of the problems of hunger and poverty.
Schools often hold activities to teach students about food.
Its message is simple: no one in the world should go hungry.
exercises.translation_cn: 世界粮食日每年十月举行;在一百五十多个国家庆祝;这一天提醒人们关注饥饿与贫困问题;学校常举办活动让学生了解粮食;它的信息很简单:世界上不该有人挨饿。

questions.stem: When is World Food Day held?
In how many countries is it celebrated?
options: In more than one hundred and fifty countries.

questions.stem: What does the day remind people of?
options: The problems of hunger and poverty.

questions.stem: What do schools often do on this day?
options: Hold activities to teach students about food.

questions.stem: What is the message of World Food Day?
